subject: Unforeseen electrical field condition: junction box location conflicting with the ceiling

messages.text: We de-energized the circuit and logged the junction box location conflicting with the ceiling grid layout at Mechanical Room 3B in today's field log; this isn't reflected in Sheet E-501. This is becoming a priority as work proceeds nearby. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. This is holding up work in this area. Please respond within five days so we can proceed.
